entries.title: Compositional Meta-Learning for Mitigating Task Heterogeneity in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
entries.titleJa: 物理情報ニューラルネットのタスク不均一性を緩和する合成的メタ学習
entries.titleEn: Compositional Meta-Learning for Mitigating Task Heterogeneity in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
entries.summaryJa: 物理情報ニューラルネットワーク(PINN)のメタ学習において、タスク間の異質性が学習を阻害する問題に対し、合成的なメタ学習手法を提案。共有成分とタスク固有成分に分離することで、多様な物理タスクへの汎化性能を向上させる。
entries.summaryEn: This paper proposes a compositional meta-learning approach for Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) that mitigates task heterogeneity by decomposing knowledge into shared and task-specific components, improving generalization across diverse physics tasks.

image.alt: Compositional Meta-Learning for Mitigating Task Heterogeneity in Physics-Informed Neural Networks

entries.summaryEn: This paper proposes a novel framework that formulates binary spiking neural networks (SNNs) as causal models, treating spike events as interventions to enable causal-inference-based interpretation and analysis of SNN behavior.

image.alt: Binary Spiking Neural Networks as Causal Models

entries.title: When Roles Fail: Epistemic Constraints on Advocate Role Fidelity in LLM-Based Political Statement Analysis
